EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK

Wrenfield Analytics, Inc.
Effective April 1, 2026

INTRODUCTION

This Handbook describes the policies and practices that apply to employees of Wrenfield Analytics, Inc. It is not a contract of employment. Employment at Wrenfield is at-will: either you or the Company may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without notice. No manager, supervisor, or representative of the Company other than the Chief Executive Officer has authority to alter the at-will relationship, and any such alteration must be in a writing signed by the Chief Executive Officer.

The Company may change, suspend, or withdraw any policy in this Handbook at any time, except the at-will policy, which may be changed only as described above.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Wrenfield provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. This applies to hiring, promotion, compensation, training, discipline, and termination.

ANTI-HARASSMENT AND COMPLAINT PROCEDURE

Harassment based on any protected characteristic is prohibited. If you experience or witness harassment, report it to your manager, to any member of the People team, or to the Employee Relations line at 1-800-555-0134. You may report anonymously. The Company will investigate promptly and will not retaliate, and will not tolerate retaliation by anyone, against a person who reports in good faith or participates in an investigation.

MEAL AND REST PERIODS

Non-exempt employees receive an unpaid meal period of at least thirty minutes when they work more than five hours in a day, and a paid rest period of ten minutes for every four hours worked or major fraction thereof. Do not work through a meal period without prior written approval from your manager.

OVERTIME

Non-exempt employees are paid overtime at one and one-half times the regular rate for hours worked over forty in a workweek, and as otherwise required by state law. All overtime must be approved in advance, but the Company pays for all hours actually worked whether or not approved.

PAID TIME OFF AND SICK LEAVE

Full-time employees accrue paid time off at 1.54 hours per pay period. Paid sick leave accrues at one hour for every thirty hours worked, and may be used for the employee's own health condition or to care for a family member, consistent with applicable state and local law. Accrued, unused paid time off is paid out at separation where required by state law.

LEAVES OF ABSENCE

Eligible employees may take leave under the Family and Medical Leave Act, and under applicable state family and medical leave laws. The Company provides reasonable accommodation for disability and for pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions, and engages in the interactive process on request.

ACKNOWLEDGMENT

I have received the Employee Handbook. I understand it is not a contract, that my employment is at-will, and that the Company may change its policies at any time.
